items.title: Chico Freeman interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001
items.q: My father, my family, the Freeman family, my father has two brothers. Bruz Freeman and George Freeman. Bruz is a drummer and George is a guitarist. They all played with Charlie Parker.

ctx.x: Wow. Now these guys are pretty modern players too. I guess I had this impression, I have to readjust my thinking, that they were pretty up to date. In other words they were not just playing swing.

No. Well you see my history goes even further back than that. My father, my family, the Freeman family, my father has two brothers. Bruz Freeman and George Freeman. Bruz is a drummer and George is a guitarist. They all played with Charlie Parker. But prior to that, at that time they were the premier band in Chicago. My father is a legend and so are my uncles. But my grandfather is also one, he was one of the first black policemen on the Chicago police force, and my grandmother, my father’s mother and father,…
And King Oliver and all those?
